verdict.rationale: Hands-on community evidence says n8n keeps past executions and shows the data going in and out of each component. The vendor also claims agent reasoning steps are traceable on the canvas. Together these cover the per-step input/output inspection part of the story, but nothing in the pack documents testing with sample or pinned data before going live. missing for 10: documented pinned/sample data testing, first-party docs on manual test runs and the per-node input/output panel, evidence that inspection works pre-production rather than only on historical executions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test a workflow with sample or pinned data and inspect each step's input and output before going live

citations.quote: It keeps all the historical executions so you can see what happened when workflows failed and what data was going in/out of each component.
Every step of your agents' reasoning, traceable on the canvas.
